provenance: All numeric values below are development assumptions, not measured CSS, IMU, camera or aircraft specifications. Literature supports mechanisms, not this combined profile.

confirmation_record.path: ../最小可行方案_逐项确认清单_20261111.md
confirmation_record.scope: User-confirmed simulation development conditions: visual markers plus IMU; uncertain surveyed launch pose; continuous pre-wake listening without receive-power study; obstacle-free 120x80 m at 15 m, 5 then 10 terminals; 20 m per-terminal position target; 600 s full mission and 3 m return tolerance. Detailed sensor/radio/noise parameters remain assumptions; feasibility is unverified.

css.payload_mapping: ceil(8*(application_bytes+crc_bytes)/(coding_efficiency*spreading_factor)); abstract block coding, not the LoRa airtime formula
css.receive_mode: user_confirmed_continuous_listening_before_logical_wake; no receive-power study or low-power claim

duty_cycle_sensitivity.note: optional later scenario, excluded from initial MVP; derive repeated-frame coverage and revised dwell before enabling

ranging.baseline_probability_scope: development Bernoulli adapter inside declared radius; not a calibrated service guarantee
ranging.no_double_count: range_white_std excludes separately modeled clock residual; persistent bias enters joint covariance, not each diagonal as independent noise

navigation_candidate.initial_pose_source: user-confirmed simulation condition: surveyed launch pad and known placement direction supply uncertain pose prior; numerical uncertainty remains a development assumption; static IMU aids gravity alignment but not yaw; downward camera updates start only after visibility checks
navigation_candidate.survey_error_model: persistent reference-pose nuisance states with joint covariance; never redraw at each observation
navigation_candidate.extrinsic_model: body z points upward; camera optical z points downward; matrices and lever arms are exact only in the nominal development profile

motion_and_budget.time_scope: takeoff start through physical return and landing; model computation delay included, actual solver CPU time reported separately

localization.risk_note: chi-square gates describe nominal model consistency; they do not guarantee false acceptance probability or full-mission accuracy

planner.information_rule: only current observations and known models; planning random stream independent of physical future
planner.status: candidate method; novelty and gain unverified
